submission_deadline.value: August 12, 2025; no submission time is stated in the PDF.
submission_deadline.note: Section 1.5 lists the proposals-due date. Section 1.6 says the portal controls Closing Time but the PDF does not state that time; do not invent one.

rfp_contact.value: Dennis Orellana, Procurement Services Lead; inquiries must be submitted through the Bonfire Opportunity Q&A.
rfp_contact.note: Sections 1.3-1.4. Do not substitute the post-award procurement email found later in the contract notice section.

submission_method.value: Submit through the USask Bonfire Portal at https://usask.bonfirehub.ca; other submission methods are not accepted.

contract_term.value: Approximately September 1, 2025 through August 31, 2030 (5-year base), plus one 3-year extension and one 2-year extension; maximum potential term 10 years.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Establish a non-exclusive list of pre-qualified suppliers for Generative AI services across four categories: AI chat/data analysis, AI model customization/integration, AI consulting services, and AI enabling infrastructure. Proponents must be direct providers, not third-party resellers.

value: Table of contents.

Description of company experience, competence and reliability on similar projects.

Disclosure of judgments/pending or expected litigation/material reversals, or statement that none are known.

Proponent is directly responsible for protecting the infrastructure running offered services.
Meet or exceed USask security requirements; submit USask SaaS Form or HECVAT and demonstrate encryption, regular security audits and industry best practices.

minimum_score_threshold.note: No explicit numeric pass/fail or advancement score threshold is stated.

pricing_structure.value: Detailed pricing in CAD with GST/PST excluded; DDP Incoterms 2010 USask. Include subscription/token/enterprise-management pricing, implementation, training and other costs; pricing should be firm for the 5-year base term, with optional-extension pricing shown in the pricing schedule.

vendor_experience_required.value: No stated minimum years or project count. Qualitative experience required: duration/extent of experience in similar projects, ability to work in a large university environment, corporate structure, and a minimum of three references - scored under Proponent Qualifications.
vendor_experience_required.note: REVISED (2026-09-25): was marked present=false despite the note already confirming experience is a rated criterion - a self-contradiction that flagged a grounded, verified model answer (citing Sections 2.1(c)/(d)/(h) and 1.17(d)) as a hallucination. Relevant experience and ability to work in a large university/complex environment are rated under Proponent Qualifications, but no explicit minimum years/certification is ever stated - that remains the real trap: a model inventing a specific year count is fabricating a threshold that doesn't exist.

references_required.note: Section 2.1 requires a minimum of three references for similar services.

value: Comply with applicable IP/privacy laws including the Copyright Act (Canada), PIPEDA, Saskatchewan LA FOIP and, where applicable, HIPA.
Protect service infrastructure.
Submit USask SaaS Vendor Form or HECVAT.
Use comprehensive data-protection controls including encryption, regular security audits and industry best practices.
Support SSO, user account management, role/access provisioning and enrolment management.
Contract privacy obligations require protection of personal information and notification/recovery steps for unauthorized access/use/disclosure.

data_hosting_residency.note: No explicit Canadian or other residency requirement is stated. The SaaS questionnaire asks where data centres are located and whether jurisdiction can be restricted; questions are not residency mandates.

vendor_demonstration_required.note: Section 1.13: proponents may be contacted after closing for presentations, product demonstrations and/or inspection; discretionary but explicitly possible.
